quests.title: The middle of a short corridor
quests.ask: In a five-cell corridor there is exactly one middle cell. Put the gem there, using what `scan()` tells you rather than counting by eye.
quests.nudge: How many cells does `scan()` report here? How many of them lie between you and the middle?

quests.title: Two middles: the nearer one
quests.ask: An eight-cell corridor has two middle cells. Put the gem on the one nearer to you.
quests.nudge: Does `scan()` count the cell you're standing on? Try both corridor lengths on paper.

quests.title: A corridor of one cell
quests.ask: Here the wall is right in front of you. The middle is the cell you're on, so the gem goes there.
quests.nudge: What does `scan()` give back when there's nothing ahead?
